personality.description: This person tends to seek out new ideas, ask curious questions, and bring inventive suggestions into everyday situations, while keeping enough structure to stay reasonably on track without becoming rigid. In social settings, they are usually warm, energetic, and talkative, often encouraging others and trying to keep interactions friendly and inclusive. When facing moral dilemmas, they typically feel the emotional weight strongly, look for a compassionate solution that minimizes harm, and hesitate if a choice might upset others. Because they are sensitive to stress, they may overthink difficult decisions and need reassurance before settling on a course of action.
